answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1253 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the jetty. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the lagoon queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The raven index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 478 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
